Android country-ranges.bin.gz is a country-only range index derived from this database.
Transformation: city names/coordinates removed, adjacent same-country ranges merged.
Build tool: tools/build_country_ranges.py. App About screen provides attribution.
Panel footer provides visible attribution to DB-IP. No endorsement is implied.
